GUIDELINES ISSUED BY THE ELECTION COMMISSION IN ADDITION TO THE MEDIAGUIDELINES PUBLISHED BY THE GAZETTE No. 2147/87 OF 21.09.2019 AND GAZETTENo. 2146/39 OF 27.10.2019

“SILENT PERIOD” in regard to Election Propaganda is the period commencing forty-eight hours before the date fixed for thepoll and ending with the declaration of the result. Publicity should not be given to promote or prejudice any political party orcandidate by way of propaganda or advertisement during this period.

However, reports of public meetings held on the day prior to the silent period to promote political parties orcandidates can be broadcast and telecast only once on radio and television channels in their news bulletins on the followingday, giving equal time periods for contesting parties or candidates. In print media, such news about the final public meetingsshould be published only on the day that follows the meeting, without giving any special favour to any party or candidate.
